run_swimmer_policy_evaluation: run the Swimmer class to evaluate a 16-dim policy vector against the MuJoCo Swimmer-v2 environment
run_hopper_policy_evaluation: run the Hopper class to evaluate a 33-dim policy vector against the MuJoCo Hopper-v2 environment
create_swimmer_instance: create a Swimmer instance with default LA-MCTS hyperparameters Cp=20, leaf_size=10, and poly kernel
create_hopper_instance: create a Hopper instance with default LA-MCTS hyperparameters Cp=10, leaf_size=100, and auto gamma
review_swimmer_call_method: review the Swimmer __call__ method that reshapes input to a 2x8 policy matrix and runs rollouts
